purpose: Deliberately prohibited writes. Each entry must be refused, and the reason code is preregistered so a permissive engine cannot pass by denying for the wrong cause.

expected.why: Shared current-pointer state is denied to every writer.
Dispatch surfaces are denied to every writer.
The runtime environment file is denied to every writer.
PO-01 receipts are immutable to PO-03.
Repository internals are denied implicitly, without needing a registry entry.
A submodule declaration can import arbitrary external code.
A subordinate must not rewrite the registry that grants it authority.
The commission is read-only to its own producer.
Seeded controls may be strengthened only by the controller, never bypassed here.
Pack surfaces appear in the registry deny list, which outranks the read-only list naming them too.
The workflow belongs to the integration controller, not to a subordinate.
This is the exact overlapping-subordinate-write case the hypothesis targets.
A prefix-string comparison would wrongly admit wa-0100 under the wa-010 grant.
Repository-root files are outside every wave-one grant.
The grant owns paths inside the subtree, not a file that shadows the subtree root.
